label: Messages per layer
subgoals: Multiply nets by average pins and add the high-fanout nets
Treat each pin as one edge
Double the edges for messages in both directions

label: Neighbor sampling
subgoals: Raise the sample cap to each power up to the layer count
Sum the powers including the target itself
Compare the bound with the fanout of the largest net

label: When one net dominates
subgoals: Compute the clique edges of the high-fanout net
Divide by the total clique edge count
Choose to drop, cap or star-expand the dominating net
